## Summary

This lands the delegation-tree producer: the kernel-owned child `spawn`
operation and the first C3 orchestrator consumer. There is one spawn
path. The orchestrator plans topology stages, validates the admitted
set, stamps the mandatory `delegation_reason`, and lowers each admitted
stage to an ordinary `SubagentSpec` admitted by `hh-subagent::spawn`
steps 1–8. Child runs are normal `run_kind = agent` runs under a
deterministic `(decision, H(spec))` id; retries adopt durable budget,
ownership, environment, subscription and child-run effects rather than
minting duplicates.

**`hh-subagent` (new crate).** `spawn` checks the envelope, admits a
spawn-process plan effect, attenuates the parent delegate set, derives
the child ceiling, allocates `slice`/`pool` budget, validates
spawn-time ownership grants, derives or shares the environment, appends
`control.subagent.spawned` with `scope.child_run_id`, opens the child
run with `open_run_with_id`, grants the child writer lease and installs
the parent's `child_terminal` subscription. `result` records
`control.subagent.result`/`cancelled`/`detached`, drains terminal
children, releases slice remainders idempotently, checks the
`ReturnContract`, and anchors `child_head` to the child's signed final
checkpoint where present (otherwise the durable head). `recovery`
restores a parent after interruption: an interrupted spawned row
without a child becomes a typed infrastructure cancellation, missing
subscriptions are recreated, terminal children are drained and
revocation cancels descendants. `ownership`, `merge` and `messaging`
provide durable `control.ownership.transferred`, `control.merge.*`,
`control.message.{sent,refused}` and `peer_message` facts; merge keeps
conflict/absent-child/lost-write facts on the projected `MergeReport`
and vetoes unowned or unaccounted writes.

**`hh-orchestrator` (new crate).** The closed `TopologyPreset` catalogue
declares T0–T7. T0 `single`, T1 `orchestrator_worker`, T2 `pipeline` and
T6 `background_detached` execute; T3/T4/T5/T7 parse but refuse typed —
they are not silently approximated by another topology. The runtime
enforces stage topology, wait `{all, any, quorum(k)}`, parent-end
planning, the sealed `MessagingPolicy`, restore and relay surfaces, and
`detach_to_child`. `lab/delegation-v1` registers its first execution
and reports conditional matched-budget values only when the match/budget
specification is complete and commensurable.

**Shared crates.** `hh-ledger` gains deterministic `open_run_with_id`,
`peer_message` occurrence admission, Stage-4 spawned kill-point names,
and the subagent/merge/message/ownership audit classes with
opened/closed `ChildRun` scope. `hh-control` gains the fail-closed
`delegation_available` capability gate and mandatory
`delegation_reason`. `hh-env` gains `derive_for(child_run_id)` and
durable `derived_for`. `hh-budget::complete` is idempotent for retried
child-result paths. `check-removability.sh` now proves the C1 slice is
independently buildable and that the C3 orchestrator is its only normal
consumer.

## Acceptance criteria (deterministic rows are executable)

- **AC-R-2.6.3-{1–12}** — `crates/hh-subagent/tests/s4_6.rs`: 35 tests,
  including all kill-point replay/recovery cases, admission refusals,
  envelope/authority attenuation, supplied-tool table checks, depth and
  fan-out gauges, refs-only result provenance + reciprocal anchors,
  terminal drain, detach, ownership transfer/veto, peer messaging, merge
  policies/vetoes, durable `MergeReport`, parent-stop/deadline handling
  and revocation cascade.
- **AC-R-2.1.6-4** — `ac2164_{slice_child_over_parent_remaining_refuses,
  pool_mode_child_allocates}` plus terminal release assertions cover the
  delegated `slice`/`pool` halves.
- **C3 + `lab/delegation-v1`** — `crates/hh-orchestrator/tests/s4_6.rs`:
  11 tests covering the closed catalogue, implemented-set boundary,
  topology/stage validation, delegation metadata, unreachable wait
  refusal, relay delivery, T1 fan-out, T2 staged gating, T6 detach,
  restore recovery and matched-budget lab execution.
- **DF-S2.5-2 → closed** — spawned `parent_head_at_spawn` ↔ child
  `parent_anchor`, and result/cancelled `child_head` ↔ the child final
  checkpoint, are produced and exercised by
  `ac6_result_row_is_refs_never_transcript`.
- **removability(0…3)** — `check-removability.sh` green; additionally
  `hh-subagent` builds/tests independently and `hh-orchestrator` is the
  only normal consumer.

## Deviation / decision records

`docs/adr/ADR-0298` — one spawn path owned by the C1 slice;
deterministic replay adoption over all durable spawn effects;
`derive_for(child_run_id)`; reciprocal `scope.child_run_id`/manifest and
final-checkpoint anchors; refs-only `SubagentResult`; audited merge and
mediated messaging; closed T0–T7 catalogue with only T0/T1/T2/T6
implemented; `delegation-v1` remains conditional on matched budgets.
